name: Bastar Heritage & Waterfalls Corridor
description: Famous for Chitrakote, Tirathgarh, indigenous art and Dandami Maria culture.

name: Kanger Valley Eco Corridor
description: Subterranean limestone caves, Sal forests, and endangered Bastar hill myna habitat.

name: Sirpur Archaeological Corridor
description: Ancient Buddhist monasteries, 7th century Laxman Temple, and Mahanadi river basin.

name: Bhoramdeo Heritage Circuit
description: 11th-century Nagara temple architecture and Maikal hill range tribal sanctuaries.

name: Mainpat Hill Station Zone
description: The Shimla of Chhattisgarh — Tibetan settlements, Jaljali bouncing earth, and Tiger Point falls.

name: Raipur Urban & Cultural Corridor
description: Vivekananda Sarovar, Purkhouti Muktangan open-air tribal museum, and modern heritage hub.

name: Hasdeo Forest & Water Corridor
description: Bango Dam, Kendai falls, and ancient dense Sal canopy forest.

name: Ratanpur Sacred Temple Circuit
description: Historical capital of Kalachuris with Mahamaya Temple and ancient sacred tanks.

name: Danteshwari Spiritual Corridor
description: 52nd Shakti Peeth at confluence of Shankini and Dankini rivers, and Bailadila hills.

name: Barnawapara Wildlife Reserve Zone
description: Teak and bamboo sanctuary teeming with Indian bison, leopards, and flying squirrels.

name: Champaran Cultural Corridor
description: Birthplace of saint Vallabhacharya and holy Mahanadi confluence.

name: Madku Dweep Pilgrimage Island
description: Historic river island with excavated 10th-century stone temple ruins on Shivnath river.

name: Achanakmar Biosphere Corridor
description: Pristine tiger reserve, part of Achanakmar-Amarkantak UNESCO biosphere reserve.
